(AP Photo/Darren Abate)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Khadrice Rollins | KRollins@masslive.comA potential first round playoff matchup out West is also just the Monday action on March 16 at the Intuit Dome in Inglewood, Calif, where the LA Clippers are hosting the San Antonio Spurs.This NBA game is scheduled to start at 10 p.m. EDT and will be broadcast on Peacock and FanDuel Sports Network SoCal. Fans looking to watch can do so for free by using DIRECTV, which offers a free trial, or FuboTV, which also offers a free trial as well as up to $30 off your first month. Peacock has plans starting at $10.99 a month and has exclusive NBA games on Mondays and also allows fans to watch games that are broadcast on NBC.
